hookReports.note: Includes metadata and enqueue overhead; excludes 250ms batch flush I/O, trace and renderer observer overhead.

limitations: COMMIT return is SQLite API completion, not disk fsync.
DOM/rAF are not paint; Paint/DrawFrame are actual Chromium trace events but do not prove physical monitor scanout.
A first subsequent renderer Paint is not proof that every target-message pixel belongs to that Paint.
Clock offsets bounded by CDP mark-call round trips; probe/tracing overhead is present.
